The <b>bloody nails</b> are a quest item dropped by [[Monsters#Heavy-Hitters|iron maidens]] in the [[dungeon]]. The player needs to deliver '''5x''' to [[Snake]] upon request. Alternatively, they can simply be washed at the [[cooking table]] to create ordinary [[nails]].

Note that there are a finite number of bloody nails in the game, since iron maidens do not respawn; if you discard or wash all of them before delivering five to Snake, the game will become unwinnable.
